Belavadós.note: The Iron Dominion detonated its anti-matter and dark-matter weapon against Belavadós, destroying the continent in 276 CE. Settlement maps serve as pre-destruction historical reconstructions unless a later survival or rebuilding era is explicitly authored.

Tzaphaer.note: Tzaphaer is not the site of the 276 CE detonation. It was not fully conquered by the Dominion in the historical timeline. Trade pressure or agents there are optional scenario hooks, not documented annexations.

Arzuhan.note: Iron Dominion expansion reached Zephonarai; its political collapse ignited rebellions across Arzuhan.

Dakaroth.note: The 65 CE Dawn of Steam arose in the Kingdom of Ruqore in volcanic Dakaroth; the Ruqorakai later industrialized and expanded beyond it.

timeline.title: Rise of the Ruqorakai
timeline.text: Arcano-industrialism emerges in Dakaroth. Steam machinery (78 CE), leyline factories (91–115 CE), skyships (105–120 CE), and rail (115–135 CE) give the emerging Iron Dominion leverage beyond its borders.

timeline.title: Coercive expansion into Zephonarai
timeline.text: Theramali falls in 102 CE. Phaliranara, Yoeraluma, Zephomali and Erynamali are among the settlements razed or annexed in 104–118 CE. Last highland strongholds are taken in 125–138 CE; Zephonarai is subdued by 145 CE.

timeline.title: Divine upheaval amid industrial ascendancy
timeline.text: New divinities and religious opposition shape the Classical world. Theraeon's 182 CE exile belongs to the period of Dominion expansion. No deity is diminished during the Classical Era.

timeline.title: Dominion pressure near Belavadós
timeline.text: Classical playable pressure includes industrial concessions, coercive transport privileges, arcane resource acquisition, embassy interference and agent networks in Belavadós and neighboring continents. These are proposed encounter lenses, not assertions about specific unnamed settlements.

timeline.title: Destruction of Belavadós
timeline.text: The Ruqorakai/Iron Dominion unleashes the anti-matter and dark-matter detonation against Belavadós, destroying the continent. Tzaphaer is not the detonation target.

timeline.title: Terminal collapse of the Iron Dominion
timeline.text: The 276 CE weapon catastrophe triggers terminal political disintegration. Arzuhan faces rebellions; the Iron Dominion's final collapse is complete in 289 CE.

timeline.title: Post-Dominion successor powers
timeline.text: Kaelrion, Phalirava and Vulkiris take shape amid the old Dominion's collapse and the wider upheaval. Their later history belongs to the Classical period, before the Traditional Era begins in 828 CE.
